source_identity.formulation_note: J7 post-correction w0=8; this diagnostic does not change that implementation

loading_and_boundary.type: prescribed affine displacement on every outer-boundary node; no external nodal traction
loading_and_boundary.free_dofs: all displacement components on strictly interior mesh nodes

distortion.invariant: bubble vanishes on every exterior face; outer coordinates, boundary mesh, topology, material and prescribed physical field remain fixed

reference.type: independent homogeneous 3D elasticity solution for uniaxial extension with zero lateral stress
reference.limitations: affine constant-strain patch benchmark; does not exercise non-affine field accuracy or validate the general HEX8-SRI formulation

observables: minimum and maximum 2x2x2 Gauss Jacobian determinants
free stiffness condition estimate and free residual
interior displacement error against the affine field
strain energy against the continuum value
assembled volume and exterior coordinate invariance

criteria.mechanical_acceptance_thresholds: none; errors and condition estimates are descriptive
criteria.verdict_scope: exploratory only; J7 historical FAIL verdicts remain unchanged

execution.semantics: wall/output limits are enforced by the runner; RSS/process/temp/archive are sampled monitors and not OS quotas
